title: World Aquatics competition pools
edition: FINA Facilities Rules 2017–2021 (FR 2) with the World Aquatics swimming pool certification checklist of 2026-03-11 (Part 2)
notes: Applies to pools marked for competition (the competition templates, or class competition), chosen always. The owner's answer to POOLS_PLAN.md Question 5: ship FINA 2017–2021 with the 2026 checklist's changes, each finding saying to verify against the current World Aquatics text. Olympic and World Championship pools need more (2.5 m deep, 25 m wide, 10 lanes): not checked yet.

pool.description: Between the touch pads, 50.000 m or 25.000 m, +0.010 / −0.000 m (wall to wall 50.020–50.030 m with pads at both ends)
pool.note: verify against the current World Aquatics text

pool.description: Lanes at least 2.5 m wide; the first and last at least 2.4 m with at least 0.1 m outside them (FR 2017: 2.5 m and 0.2 m)
pool.note: verify against the current World Aquatics text

pool.description: At least 1.0 m deep everywhere for competitions other than the Olympic Games and World Championships
pool.note: verify against the current World Aquatics text

pool.description: At least 1.35 m deep from 1.0 m to 6.0 m out from the end wall where starting platforms are used
pool.note: verify against the current World Aquatics text

pool.description: A starting platform's top 0.50–0.75 m above the water
pool.note: verify against the current World Aquatics text
